title: Reject exact-assumption profile mismatches
description: Return specific refusal reasons for layout identity, revision, fingerprint, contradictory setup, loading-procedure, and print-configuration mismatches and prevent profile reuse.
acceptanceCriteria: Each mismatch class returns its own stable machine-readable reason and clear next action
One request can report all applicable reasons in canonical order
Any listed mismatch prevents profile correction from being applied
Layout fingerprint mismatch is refused even when human-readable layout names match

steps.details: Define stable reason codes and actions for every identity, revision, fingerprint, and contradictory setup/configuration field in the PRD.
Extend the central evaluator to accumulate mismatches deterministically and set incompatible/recalibration outcomes without early ambiguous exit.
Guard preparation inputs so an incompatible profile contributes no translation or other correction data.
Add table-driven tests for every single mismatch, combined mismatches, same-name/different-fingerprint layouts, and stable actions/order.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; extend the central reason matrix and correction guard only.
A mismatch describes recorded assumptions; it does not establish physical behavior.
Never fall back to stale correction when evaluation fails.
